problems.reason: Both sentences state that Smith and Pol named the genus and species in 2007.
The clause "which was located about 1000 km farther north at the time" refers to the South Pole, not to Glacialisaurus itself.
The fossil age is given as 186–182 Ma (Pliensbachian) in sentence 26, but sentence 27 states 190 Ma, a different estimate.
Both sentences claim Glacialisaurus lived in Antarctica during the Early Jurassic, repeating the same fact.
Both sentences classify Glacialisaurus as a massospondylid, repeating the same taxonomic assignment.
Sentence 9 describes Cryolophosaurus as a pterosaur, but Cryolophosaurus is actually a theropod dinosaur, so the sentence is about the wrong group.
